caption: The drawing features a horizontally-oriented rectangular strip with a light beige background bordered by green and black. On the left side, there is a male human figure with a pointed green hat, brown clothing, and blue accents, holding a goblet in his right hand and gesturing toward a brown animal, possibly a cow, which is standing beside him. Behind the animal is a small green plant, and there are blue and pink flowers on both the far left and above the animal. To the right of the animal, there is another green plant. The right half of the drawing shows a large, colorful bird with yellow, blue, and green feathers and a black beak, perched on a branch adorned with large blue flowers with pink centers, green leaves, and smaller red buds. The scene is rendered in a flat, folk-art style with simple outlines and filled colors.
title: Belt
